materials.title: CSDIY catalog snapshot for MIT Web Development Crash Course
materials.permitted_use: Course identity, prerequisite, technology, resource pointers, and provenance only

blocked.title: Recordings
blocked.reason: The snapshot only says to refer to the course website and supplies no recording URLs or recording content.
blocked.unblock_condition: A later authorized retrieval job locates accessible recordings, records their provenance and access terms, and validates their relationship to a course unit.

blocked.title: Assignments
blocked.reason: The snapshot only says to refer to the course website and includes no assignment text, files, or direct assignment URLs.
blocked.qualification: The source-derived flag does not make missing assignment content available.
blocked.unblock_condition: A later authorized retrieval job obtains openly accessible assignment records, preserves provenance, and validates their official status and unit boundaries.

later_job_requirements: Use an explicitly authorized retriever and obey access controls and licensing.
Record the resolved URL, retrieval time, content hash, license or access status, and source relationship.
Classify each retrieved item before creating or changing a unit node.
Keep unavailable or failed retrieval records rather than representing them as course content.
